Tencent Cloud recognizes and translates speech in real time.\nThe translation service cannot be changed separately.

Use xAI streaming recognition with a separate text translator of your choice.\nGrok Voice is also available for translation after speech pauses.
Enable Model Studio and create an API key. Simultaneous translation also requires a Beijing workspace ID.
Create an OpenAI API project and key with Realtime access. ChatGPT subscriptions do not include API usage.
Create a Gemini API key in Google AI Studio and check Live API availability for your project.

Create an Azure OpenAI resource supporting Realtime. Simultaneous translation needs translation and transcription deployments. ASR + MT needs only a transcription deployment, with text translation configured separately. Use your actual deployment names.
Verify your account and enable Simultaneous Interpretation 2.0 in the new Doubao Voice console. Mimi uses the new API key, not the legacy AppID/access token.

Realtime speech translation requires your account AppID and a SecretID / SecretKey pair from the same account. Find AppID on Account Information, not UIN; find the pair on CAM API Keys. Enable the service in the ASR console. A single Hunyuan model API key cannot authenticate this API. Pay-as-you-go must be enabled explicitly.
Create a Machine Translation app in Baidu AI Cloud with realtime speech translation access. AppKey means the app\'s API Key, not Secret Key.

Get an API key in xAI Console and check access and credits for the xAI models you use. Save the Grok text translation key separately; you may enter the same existing key as recognition or use different keys.

ASR + MT
Simultaneous translation
Model Studio Beijing workspace ID

Simultaneous translation returns original text and translations as you listen. It needs a Beijing workspace ID and API key, recognizes speech automatically, and supports 60 translation languages.\nASR + MT recognizes text first, then translates with your chosen service. Stop subtitles before switching.
Translation mode
Simultaneous translation
ASR + MT

Simultaneous translation returns original text and translations directly. ASR + MT recognizes speech, then translates it with your chosen text service. Both configurations are retained. Stop subtitles to switch.
Quick setup
Custom

Prefills an editable service address; some model IDs must be entered. Choose an enabled or locally downloaded model. Match the address to your account region, product and API key. Text translation and speech recognition use separate credentials.
Get API key
Setup guide
Install and set up
No API key needed
Could not open the official setup page. Try again.
Choose a project on the OpenAI API platform, create an API key and paste it here. Enter a model ID available to that project; a ChatGPT subscription is not an API key.
Create a key under API keys on the DeepSeek platform and paste it here. Copy an available model name from the official model list or API example, then save and check translation.

Choose a region and workspace in Model Studio, create an API key and paste it here. Enter a model ID enabled in that workspace. The preset uses Beijing; change the address if your key belongs to another region.
Choose a project in Google AI Studio, create a Gemini API key and paste it here. Enter a model ID available to that key; a Gemini subscription is not an API key.

Create a key in API Key management on the Kimi API platform and enter a model ID available to that account. Do not use a Kimi Code key. International accounts need the matching international address and key console.

Create a key under API keys in the SiliconFlow console and paste it here. Copy the full model ID from the model catalog, including its provider prefix. Use an address and key from the same regional site.
Create an API key in OpenRouter key settings and paste it here. Copy the complete provider/model slug from the model page and confirm your account can call it.

The official public endpoint needs no API key. Keep the prefilled address and model; do not enter a key from another service. Save and check translation. Availability depends on the upstream public service.

Create a key on the Tencent TokenHub API Key page and copy an enabled model ID from its model list. The preset uses Guangzhou. Match the region, product and key; Tencent speech SecretID/SecretKey credentials cannot be used here.

In Baidu AI Cloud, open Security authentication → API Key and create a key with Qianfan access. Paste it here and enter an enabled Qianfan model ID. Baidu speech-translation AppID/AppKey credentials cannot be used here.

Choose a project in Volcano Ark, create an API key and paste it here. Enter an enabled model or inference endpoint ID. The preset uses the ordinary Beijing API; Coding-plan or Doubao Speech keys are not substitutes.
Install Ollama, download a local model and run it first. Enter its complete local model name here. The default local server needs no API key; you do not need to create an Ollama cloud key.

Download and load a model in LM Studio, start the server on its Developer page and copy the model identifier here. No API key is needed by default. If server authentication is enabled, enter that server’s token.
